interpretation.nested_intervals: Owner phases and validation categories are inclusive. Compilation time is included in configuration time. Planning occurs inside decision and resume. Settlement and apply_transaction occur inside resume. Never sum parent and child timings.
interpretation.settlement: The settlement owner includes reconciliation, identity allocation verification/commit, canonical hashing, journal updates, autosave persistence/proof, and profile proof/persistence. Each observed settlement includes 28 reading configurations and 2581 compiler calls. Its elapsed time is not pure disk I/O.
interpretation.snapshot_coverage: All four snapshot_validations arrays are empty and observed snapshot counters are zero. This run cannot identify a largest snapshot subcategory. Absence of these observations does not establish zero snapshot validation work.
interpretation.scope: Instrumented baseline, not an optimization comparison. Differences from earlier runners are not speedups. Whole New Acc duration retains normal caption reveal; retained button-to-caption scope also includes consent dwell.
interpretation.configuration_counts: Fresh cases each configure 90 reading sessions and call the compiler 8300 times; retained cases configure 96 and call it 8853 times. Counts include cache hits and do not imply that every call reparses a file.
interpretation.physical_proof: No fresh physical-proof hook call; one retained call around 2.5 ms. These are hook observations, not proof that all physical/resource validation is absent elsewhere.
